name: Bhutan
famous_for: Tiger's Nest Monastery (Paro Taktsang), Gross National Happiness philosophy, and fortress dzongs.
tourists: Approx. 315,000 visitors; famous for Paro Taktsang, Punakha Dzong, and Dochula Pass stupas.
must_know: Smoking is strictly regulated; visitors must dress respectfully with covered shoulders and legs inside Dzongs.
fun_fact: Bhutan is the world's first carbon-negative country, absorbing more greenhouse gases than it emits.
